label: s1_l40s_w4a16_fi
note: Stage-1 screen: L40S 48GB (Ada, no FP4), Google QAT W4A16 (Marlin) + FP8 KV, max-len 32768. Rejected automatically if the global 512-dim layers run on TRITON_ATTN. FIX: vLLM 0.33 forces TRITON_ATTN on Gemma 4 when FA4 is unavailable (SM89 (Ada)); its config.py only forces when attention_config.backend is None, so --attention-backend FLASHINFER selects FlashInfer for all layers (the playbook's #47547 path).

servers.name: w4a16qat_fi
servers.launch: vllm serve /root/models/w4a16qat --served-model-name gemma --port 8000 --language-model-only --kv-cache-dtype fp8 --async-scheduling --max-num-batched-tokens 8192 --enable-prompt-tokens-details --reasoning-parser gemma4 --gpu-memory-utilization 0.94 --max-model-len 32768 --attention-backend FLASHINFER
